item.title: Update: Haldimand County making headway in clearing roads of snow
item.description: Blowing snow and white out conditions due to high winds prompted Haldimand County to declare a significant weather event at 4 p.m. on Tuesday that remains in effect. An update at 4:40 p.m. Wednesday indicated that rapidly changing weather and renewed drifting along the lakeshore area have created unpredictable road conditions.
